candidate.language: C/C++ with Dart/Kotlin/Java and other bindings

android.evidence: upstream matrix includes Android and Flutter Android

desktop.evidence: Windows, macOS and Linux are explicit upstream targets

raspberry_pi.evidence: Raspberry Pi is explicitly listed upstream and Linux aarch64 artifacts are published

extended.note: recorded as extended evidence; current Library need does not yet require iOS separately

benchmark.reason: Researcher manual proof does not execute upstream candidate code

integration_assessment.adapter_model: Library-owned voice.tts.v1 adapter over sherpa-onnx offline TTS primitives
strengths: explicit Android, desktop and Raspberry Pi support
prebuilt Android and Linux aarch64 artifacts
weaknesses: voice.tts.v1 is not detailed enough to define the final adapter API
voice/model packages vary in file layout, language coverage and size
latency, first-audio delay, realtime factor and pronunciation require device/model benchmarks
broad runtime surface should be narrowed to TTS-only behavior

recommendation: Preferred voice.tts research candidate for a cross-platform offline-first stack, subject to security admission and target/voice benchmarks.
